name: Nihar Info Global Limited
about: Nihar Info Global Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the software and e-commerce businesses in India. It operates through three segments: Rendering of Services; Sales of Goods through E-Commerce; and Trading Activities. The company sells health, dietary supplements, ayurvedic products, generic medicines, pharmaceuticals, drugs, organic food, healthcare devices, sports equipment, fitness, baby, mother care, beauty care, wellness, personal care products, and pet food, as well as travel accessories and storage and organizers for home and personal use under the ONVO brands. In addition, the company is involved in the development, trading, sale, import, and export of computer software; and researches and develops, designs, manufactures, trades, and deals computer software and hardware, as well as provision of consultancy services in the field of software development, and turnkey projects and solutions. Further, it provides platforms integrated commerce, bulk supply solutions, and corporate gifting and solutions; precious metals and gifting solutions for individual buyers, corporate customers, and special occasions; and e-commerce services. The company serves the power sector, port, infrastructure, LPO, atomic energy, defense, government, mining, and education industries. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Genesys Securities Ltd and changed its name to Nihar Info Global Limited in October 2003. Nihar Info Global Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
